parsed.internal_thinking: Jimmy is offering 2 Wheat for 1 Sheep. Looking at my current resources, I have 1 Ore, 2 Wheat, and 1 Sheep. My production at Node 20 gives me Sheep on 8 (high probability, 5 pips) and Brick on 6 (blocked by Jimmy's robber move). My production at Node 44 gives me Wheat on 6 and 9 (total 9 pips). Although Wheat is generally high for me, the Hex 18 (Wheat 9) was recently blocked by Claude, though Jimmy just moved the robber to Hex 5 (Brick 6). Jimmy's move to block the Brick 6 hurts me too, but it hurts Claude more. Accepting this trade gives me a total of 4 Wheat and 1 Ore. I need 3 Wheat and 2 Ore for a City, or 1 Wood, 1 Brick, 1 Wheat, 1 Sheep for a Settlement. I currently lack Wood and Brick. However, 2 Wheat for 1 Sheep is a very generous ratio (2:1). Even if I have Wheat production, having extra Wheat is useful for future trades or building. Since Jimmy is actively targeting Claude (who I also distrust), maintaining a good relationship with Jimmy is strategic. I will accept.
parsed.note_to_self: Accepted Jimmy's 2 Wheat for 1 Sheep. Jimmy moved the robber to Hex 5, blocking my Brick 6 but also Claude's main Brick source. I now have 4 Wheat and 1 Ore.
parsed.say_outloud: יאללה ג'ימי, הצעה הוגנת. כבשה אחת תמורת שתי חיטה זה עסקה שאני יכולה לחיות איתה, במיוחד כשצריך להתקדם פה למרות החסימות של קלוד.
